t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There is 6 different kinds of gnomes and 3 different baskets and you need to work out the best combinations to recieve the highest income of mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: I found it quite difficult myself to work out which coloured Ghome goes with which coloured basket to produce the most mushrooms. I played about a bit and a lot until I thought I'd figured it out, and then the mushroom count would change! So keep playing but I think complimentary colours have something to do with it.
